option_cues.description: Cues visible in the question and its answer options. stronger_result_option: an option says another option is correct but a stronger result can be proven. nested_strength: options are versions of one claim ordered by strength (rates, constants, bounds, endpoints, blowup versus unboundedness). quantifier_or_equivalence: options hinge on quantifiers or equivalence (for every, there exists, if and only if, exactly when, converse, characterization). threshold_or_inequality: options differ by sign, endpoint, strict versus non-strict inequality, or a parameter threshold. quantitative_estimate: options are estimates differing in exponents, constants, log factors, or convergence mode. local_vs_global: options differ by local, completed, prime-by-prime, or sufficiently-large versus global or every-case statements. Several cues may apply; use an empty list if none is recognized.
